svg.title: A conical tank combines volume and similar-triangle relationships
svg.desc: The water volume depends on both radius and depth. Similar triangles provide r/h=R/H , allowing the two changing dimensions to be expressed using one variable before differentiating. The large cone and the water cone have the same shape, so r/h=R/H . That relationship is not optional bookkeeping; it eliminates one changing variable from V=(1/3) r 2h . Only after that substitution is the volume differentiated with respect to time. The large cone and the water cone have the same shape, so r/h=R/H. Every relationship in a conical tank combines volume and similar-triangle relationships is identified with written labels plus distinct solid, dashed, dotted, double, marker, or pattern cues; color is never the only carrier of meaning. Caption: The water volume depends on both radius and depth. Similar triangles provide r/h=R/H, allowing the two changing dimensions to be expressed using one variable before differentiating. Reading order: cone-left: tank side; solid segment.; cone-right: tank side; solid segment.; rim: tank radius R; solid segment.; water: water cone with depth h and radius r; depth: water depth h; dashed segment.; radius: water radius r; solid segment.; similarity: Label: r/h = R/H.; volume: Label: V = (1/3) pi r^2 h.; order: Label: Use similarity before differentiating volume...
